notes:
Connects the five-page Meta Description repair loop end to end. A finding can become an immutable SEO repair child request, the platform derives generation readiness from actual bounded evidence, and approved candidates flow through the existing two-confirmation and runner path. The supported mappings are term SEO, homepage settings SEO, and module-page private SEO drafts; module drafts remain private until a separately authorized publication.

The repair identity is scoped to one root request and page, preserves source lineage, and is stored with constrained JSON shapes and a unique page-level relation. Candidate generation now allows clearly usable fresh evidence instead of blocking on a redundant no-op readiness recheck. The review UI and its session BFF expose the repair intent, readiness, candidate actions, and results without bypassing the API permission model.

Database migration 053 adds seo_repair_intent, seo_repair_plan, seo_repair_parent_id, and seo_repair_page_url to agent_requests, then enforces parent scope, shape, page uniqueness, and immutable repair identity. Upgrade from v0.2.31 is schema-bearing: stop b2b-platform-worker-1 and b2b-platform-dispatcher-1 before running sudo b2b-platform update v0.2.32, then verify migration 053 and restart health.

Rollback target is v0.2.31 application images. Migration 053 is additive; rollback does not down-migrate and must preserve the new columns and rows. No production WordPress content is changed by this release.

Validation before tagging: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile passed; pnpm --filter api test passed 2206 tests with 201 environment-gated skips in the main tree (including 48 unrelated uncommitted WordPress Connection tests excluded from this release); agent-control related suites passed 115 tests; clean-tree pnpm typecheck and pnpm build passed; disposable PostgreSQL 16 verification ran migrations twice and passed all six default suites with 142 tests passed and 2 environment-gated skips.
